resolved_decisions.question: Does deleting the plugin marketplace break billing-skill discovery (REQ-103/104 depend on the zbill-billing skill being invocable)?
resolved_decisions.resolution: No. Skill discovery (discoverSkills in packages/services/src/skills/skillsService.ts:840,1036,1061) reads workspace/repo skill dirs and installed plugin roots directly; the marketplace is only an install/management UI plus exclusive management RPCs (addPluginMarketplace/updatePluginMarketplace, App.tsx:844-846). Wave 1 deletes the UI surface and management RPCs, not skillsService.

resolved_decisions.question: Where exactly is the purchase-UI vs provider-connection boundary so the agent keeps model access (REQ-107)?
resolved_decisions.resolution: Delete: CodingPlanUpgradeDialog.tsx, CodingPlanEmbeddedWebviewDialog.tsx (purchase webview + completion payload), CodingPlanPurchaseChoiceBanners in model-provider-section/Detail.tsx (:594,:878), onCodingPlanPurchaseComplete plumbing (:254,:303,:638,:755), purchase-token refresh state in ModelProviderSection.tsx (:380-609,:849,:1206), codingPlanPurchaseAuth.js. Keep: ModelProviderSection base provider list/add/edit/connection and API key management.

resolved_decisions.question: Do automations/plugin-store deletions break the shared shells (App.tsx, WorkspaceShellLayout.tsx) or the web-remote-control shell?
resolved_decisions.resolution: They are conditional routes on workspaceMainView ('automations' | 'plugin-store'); removal touches route values, navigation callbacks, and their i18n keys. Web-remote-control conditionals are separate (wave 2). Shared-shell edits must keep chat/task main views and settings compiling; typecheck is the gate per slice.

resolved_decisions.question: Should the ZBILL_PRODUCT flag be retired after wave 1?
resolved_decisions.resolution: Not yet. Wave 1 removes the wave-1 surfaces at code level; the flag still gates remaining agent-surface entry points until wave 2 finishes (web remote control, device management). Retire the flag in wave 2 when every gated surface is deleted.

resolved_decisions.question: Do existing e2e/engineering tests referencing deleted surfaces block the wave?
resolved_decisions.resolution: No, if updated in the same slice: affected specs under packages/desktop/test/e2e (marketing-touch, coding-plan entitlement) are deleted or rewritten together with the surfaces; the affected-test selector is file-based and a deleted spec selects nothing. Coverage loss is recorded in the matrix row evidence, not silently.

resolved_decisions.question: Can the pipeline satisfy REQ-104 (non-EV ingestion without fabricated amounts) without new extraction intelligence?
resolved_decisions.resolution: Yes for the wave scope: build_report.py already flags unknown formats and supports items.json per-file amount/date/detail overrides; a new bill class is added as parser config + fixture + items.json, with 'flag and ask' as the failure mode. Broader extraction intelligence stays out of scope.

resolved_decisions.question: Where do archived reports live for REQ-106?
resolved_decisions.resolution: ZBill keeps a workspace-local reports directory (under the opened workspace), browsable through the existing document panel; re-export re-runs the pipeline outputs. Exact directory name and panel integration point are resolved in maker work and recorded in the change story.

resolved_decisions.question: Is deleting purchase code a payments/auth risk?
resolved_decisions.resolution: No local payment processing exists; the purchase flow is an embedded webview dialog plus token refresh calls to the remote billing API. Deleting UI and callers cannot create a payment path; remaining host handlers are dead code removed in the same slice (verified by knip/typecheck).

notes: Grill performed 2026-11-10 against the REQ-101..109 matrix after the wave-1 module-map investigation. Q7 remains assumed with a bounded maker-work resolution; it does not alter purpose, people, success signal, or non-goals.
